reports.title: Dynatrace Reports Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: Based on information available as of November 3, 2026, Dynatrace is issuing guidance for the third quarter and updating its prior guidance for full year fiscal 2027 in the tables below. This guidance reflects the expected contribution from the Arize acquisition, including approximately 200 basis points of ARR growth accretion and 175 basis points of dilution to non-GAAP operating margin for fiscal 2027.

This guidance is based on foreign exchange rates as of October 30, 2026. We expect foreign exchange to be a headwind of approximately $20 million on ARR and approximately $6 million on revenue for fiscal 2027 compared to ARR and revenue at constant currency. This represents an incremental headwind of approximately $6 million to ARR and $2 million to revenue compared to our prior guidance. This guidance also excludes the impact of any share repurchases after September 30, 2026.
Growth rates for ARR, Total revenue, and Subscription revenue are presented in constant currency to provide better visibility into the underlying growth of the business.
All growth rates below are compared to the full year and third quarter of fiscal 2026.
